build_source: Production node built from git archive of source_commit; benchmark-only files are outside that snapshot.
measurement_notes: TCP application goodput, single direction, decimal Gbit/s.
Upload uses 64 KiB framed payloads and receiver byte-count ACK, including final drain time; download uses receiver counts over the timed window.
RSS is sampled with macOS ps every approximately 200 ms; not Go live heap, kernel socket memory, or exact lifetime high-water mark.
Each memory profile uses a fresh node: idle, 32 authenticated idle streams held 4s, release 3s, 128 idle streams held 4s, release 10s.
Default kcptun client uses one KCP/smux carrier for its logical streams.
Same-host client, node and peer share CPU. Battery power; no process isolation, CPU frequency lock, added delay or packet-loss simulation.
